_comment: Tier-2 for sparta particle_emission: what 'fix emit/face' and 'fix emit/surf' reject, and the one override they accept in silence. Seven decks were run on the installed binary (SPARTA 24 Sep 2025, spa_serial). A 'fix in emit/face gas xlo' on a box declared 'boundary p o p' aborts before any stats line with 'ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face on periodic boundary (../fix_emit_face.cpp:182)'; the same fix on 'boundary o o p' runs to completion rc=0. Adding 'n 50' alone aborts with 'ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face n > 0 with perspecies yes (../fix_emit_face.cpp:100)', but adding 'perspecies no' makes it silent — rc=0, no error, no warning — and the steady particle count then tracks n, not nrho: the n=200 deck plateaus at 4.0x the n=50 deck. 'fix emit/surf gas nosuchgroup' aborts with 'ERROR: Fix emit/surf group ID does not exist (../fix_emit_surf.cpp:61)' and the same fix on a real 'group c surf id <= 50' runs. All three quoted strings were reproduced verbatim in this run; the only quantitative assertion is the RATIO between two decks of this same script, and it is bracketed 3-5, not pinned. COVERS: particle_emission:0, :4, :5 and hypersonic_flow:0 (the hypersonic row states the periodic-face restriction as its own claim string, and this script's deliberate placement of the fix at the end of the deck is what verifies its extra assertion that the check fires when the fix is DEFINED, not at run time). MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 repairs the three decks that are supposed to abort, one token each and nothing else — the periodic 'boundary p o p' becomes 'boundary o o p', the bare 'n 50' gains 'perspecies no', and the emit/surf fix is pointed at the real 'group c surf id <= 50' instead of 'nosuchgroup'. All three then exit rc=0 with zero ERROR lines: the repaired periodic deck plateaus at the same 5.762e+04 as the outflow deck and the repaired emit/surf deck at the same 1.584e+04 as the real-group deck. The two decks carrying the n-override ratio are untouched and it stays 4.007. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: emit_face_on_a_periodic_face_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face on periodic boundary (../fix_emit_face.cpp:182), emit_face_n_with_default_perspecies_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face n > 0 with perspecies yes (../fix_emit_face.cpp:100), emit_surf_group_name_does_not_exist_message=ERROR: Fix emit/surf group ID does not exist (../fix_emit_surf.cpp:61), every_quoted_emit_message_is_verbatim=True, periodic_face_is_rejected_before_any_stats_line=True. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/emit_face_periodic_and_n_override && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line.
expect_in_output: emit_face_on_a_periodic_face_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face on periodic boundary (../fix_emit_face.cpp:182)
emit_face_n_with_default_perspecies_message=ERROR: Cannot use fix emit/face n > 0 with perspecies yes (../fix_emit_face.cpp:100)
emit_surf_group_name_does_not_exist_message=ERROR: Fix emit/surf group ID does not exist (../fix_emit_surf.cpp:61)
